# parity-fuzz --mode paramod baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode paramod --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# Open gap: typeset attribute merge. A base-type change (Src/builtin.c:2355)
# deletes and recreates the param carrying ONLY READONLY|EXPORTED; any other
# typeset MERGES flags (c:2291). bin_typeset re-implements this inline and has
# it inverted: it drops -Z on an attribute add, and keeps it across a type
# change.
typeset -F x=N.N; print -r -- "$parameters[x]"; print -r -- "${(t)x}"
typeset -a x=(N N); print -r -- "$parameters[x]"; print -r -- "${(t)x}"
typeset -i x=N; print -r -- "$parameters[x]"; print -r -- "${(t)x}"
typeset -r x=ro; print -r -- "$parameters[x]"; print -r -- "${(t)x}"
